# awscc_cognito_user_pool_client_session_configuration_attachment (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClientSessionConfigurationAttachment. Manages the session configuration of a user pool app client. The settings take effect only while the user pool has UserSessionTracking ENABLED, so declaring DependsOn the AWS::Cognito::UserPoolSessionConfigurationAttachment is recommended. The service default (SSOSession MaxValidityMinutes 60) cannot be declared; remove the resource to return the app client to the default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The ID of the app client.
- `sso_session` (Attributes) Managed login single sign-on session settings for the app client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sso_session))
- `user_pool_id` (String) The ID of the user pool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--sso_session"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sso_session`

Required:

- `max_validity_minutes` (Number) The maximum time in minutes since the last authentication during which this app client can reuse an existing managed login SSO session without asking the user to sign in again. 0 means the app client always asks the user to sign in.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cognito_user_pool_client_session_configuration_attachment.example
  identity = {
    user_pool_id = "user_pool_id"
    client_id    = "client_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `client_id` (String) The ID of the app client
- `user_pool_id` (String) The ID of the user pool

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cognito_user_pool_client_session_configuration_attachment.example
  id = "user_pool_id|client_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cognito_user_pool_client_session_configuration_attachment.example "user_pool_id|client_id"
```
